lines.en: Hop. And hop again.
Ears first, then the feet.
Snow's too soft. Hard hopping.
Three hops, one pause, one listen.
Test the ground before each hop.
Rustling in the grass. Go around.
I know this little trail.
Tail flicks. I turn the corner.
Tracks in sand. Far too obvious.
I hop fast. You can't follow.
Those flowers work as landmarks.
Slope's too steep. Different way.
Mind the vine. It snaps.
One run to that tree.
Light jumps on the snow.
I hop first; step in my prints.
Ears sweep around. Nothing.
Back legs loaded. Ready to bolt.
Lick a paw. Tidy the whiskers.
Nose twitching. Can't stop it.
A moment of sun. The grass is warm.
Two thumps of a hind foot.
What was that shadow just now?
I tuck into a round ball.
A bird's calling. Annoying.
Chew a tender shoot. Slowly.
This carrot patch is mine.
A snowflake on my ear.
Hoofbeats far off. Not mine.
Counting grass blades. Getting sleepy.
Sun on my back, warm.
I licked my front paws clean.
You're so tall. I have to look up.
Your hand moved. I'm watching it.
Don't stomp. The ground shakes.
Are you a hunter or just passing?

lines.zh: 我的耳朵能听见你心跳。
lines.en: I can hear your heart from here.
Do you smell of fox?
Your boots are enormous.
One step closer and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 你在看我的脚？那是幸运的。
lines.en: Looking at my foot? It's lucky, they say.
Don't block my way home.
You blinked. I hop first.
All these people, and I fear one.
Yip! Something grabbed me!
Lost a tuft of fur. That stings.
Something bit my ear.
Leg's sore, but I can still hop.
Blood on the grass.
I'm curling up. Stay back.
Can't hop. Need a breath.
That really hurt. Truly.
Your scent is stuck to the grass now.
Endure it. Find a hole.
Carrot! Where is that carrot?
That carrot is mine.
You hold it so high. I can't reach.
Put it down. Then three steps back.
Dandelion works too. I'm not picky.
Smells like it was just pulled.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，但只到门口。
lines.en: I'll follow. Only as far as the door.

lines.zh: 再给一根，我就再靠近点。
lines.en: Another one, and I come a bit closer.
Stop waving it. I get dizzy.
A golden carrot? Wasteful.
One bite, then I run.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里还有别的吗？
lines.en: Anything else in that pocket?
Better than grass by far.
After this one, we're even.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜要脆的，别给软的。
lines.en: Crisp carrots, not soft ones.
Lower your hand and I'll take a bite.
You hit me. I hop away.
Watch my tail, you big oaf.
One of your steps, one of my tumbles.
I'm small. You don't see me.
Watch where you step, please?
Your push rolled me half over.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，你都没感觉。
lines.en: I bump you and you don't even notice.
Excuse me. I'm coming through.
You startled me. Heart's racing.
Hug the edge. Don't crowd me.
Watch how high I jump first.
My burrow's under the flowers.
Your ears are shorter than mine. No.
Ask in spring. Too cold now.
Let's dig a deeper burrow together.

lines.zh: 你跑得比我慢，我等等你。
lines.en: You're slower. I'll wait for you.
Three laps. Let me see.
Keep off my carrot patch.
Our tails match. That's a good sign.
First we outrun this fox.
This grass goes in my burrow.

lines.zh: 找到一颗掉下来的果子。
lines.en: Found a fallen berry.
A pebble? Useless. Drop it.
That hide is mine. Don't take it.
Can't run fast with a carrot in my mouth.
Hide it under the flowers. Back later.
Someone dropped breadcrumbs on the path.
Two scrapes with my front paws. Buried.
This cloth will line my burrow.
Too heavy. Can't carry it.
Fox! Run for the burrow!
A shadow dropping from the sky.

lines.zh: 那只狼在靠近，我听见了。
lines.en: That wolf is closing in. I hear it.
They found my burrow.
Into the grass. Don't run straight.
Something's digging at my hole.
The red-eyed one is back.
The cat's crouched. It wants to pounce.
Blood on the wind. Stay away.
When it moves, I hop.
I'm frozen. Can't move.
Back legs coiled. Ready to spring.
It goes left. I go right.
Heart's loud enough to hear in my ears.
Don't blink. I move right now.
I count to two, then run.
The grass moved. It's in there.
My escape route's behind me. I remember.
It lunges, I cut sideways.
Might not get away this time.
Both hind legs. Right in the nose.
I bit it. My teeth are small.
One scratch. Just one.
I charge and it backs off.
Kicked it. Now run.
It tore out a tuft of my fur.
I kick while hopping.
My claws caught its eye.
That took everything I had.
Kick, then straight into the burrow.
Under the flowers. Good cover.
Snow just stopped. Time to eat.
Tender grass here. I like it.
Ears out of the grass first.
No fox smell around.
Dig a shallow burrow. Settle in.
Another fresh meadow to explore.
Others hopping in the distance.
Soft sand. Easy digging.

lines.zh: 我的窝要隐蔽，别说出去。
lines.en: My burrow stays hidden. Tell no one.
Fur's singed. What an awful smell!
Rolled down the slope. Dizzy.
Water over my ears. Paws thrashing.
A bang. I jumped higher than ever.
Something stuck in my leg.
All numb. I can't hop.
Two days without a carrot.

lines.zh: 雷劈中旁边的树，毛全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the next tree. Fur on end.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，一直往下。
lines.en: Nothing below. Just falling.
